notes: Read all 118 source lines (numbered) before editing. The hook's own body is pure, UI-agnostic React: a promise-based confirmation state machine over useState/useCallback with no JSX, no DOM element, no Recharts/Leaflet, and no browser-only API in useConfirm itself, so the state machine ports 1:1 to React Native (Hermes runs the same useState/useCallback/Promise primitives).
L1 `import { useCallback, useState } from 'react'` preserved as `import {useCallback, useState} from 'react'` (react is RN-compatible; native prettier uses no inner-brace spacing).

L2 `import type { ConfirmDialogProps } from '@/components/ui/ConfirmDialog'` — the web ui/ConfirmDialog component is NOT yet ported (only an unrelated ai/ConfirmDialog exists in native), so following the useActiveFilterChips precedent the pure-type interface is inlined module-locally and re-exported. Inlined fields match the web ConfirmDialogProps verbatim (open, title, message, confirmLabel?, cancelLabel?, variant?: 'danger'|'warning', loading?, requireTypedConfirmation?, typedConfirmationLabel?, silenceKey?, onConfirm, onCancel), keeping the dialogProps return contract structurally identical.

L3 `import { isSilenced } from '@/lib/confirmSilence'` — the web lib reads a JSON array of silenced ids from browser localStorage; lib/confirmSilence is NOT yet ported. useConfirm consumes ONLY the read fn `isSilenced`, so just that path is inlined native-safely (useOnboardingSkip precedent): a WebStorageLike shim + getWebStorage() that prefers globalThis.localStorage when present (react-native-web target) and otherwise returns undefined, loadSilenced() mirroring the web `load()` (getItem -> JSON.parse -> Array.isArray guard -> Set(filter typeof==='string')) with defensive empty-Set on any failure, and isSilenced(key) = `if (!key) return false; return loadSilenced().has(key)`. SILENCE_STORAGE_KEY is the exact web value 'teslasync:confirm-silence:v1' so it interoperates with the future confirmSilence/ConfirmDialog native ports on the react-native-web target. Exported nativeConfirmSilenceCapabilities {durablePersistenceAvailable:false} documents the explicit unavailable state on a pure native runtime (dialog re-prompts = web safe default).

L5-9 ConfirmOptions JSDoc (mirrors ConfirmDialog visual props minus wiring fields open/onConfirm/onCancel/loading) carried over verbatim. L10-30 `ConfirmOptions` interface ported 1:1 (title, message, confirmLabel?, cancelLabel?, variant?: 'danger'|'warning', requireTypedConfirmation?, typedConfirmationLabel?, silenceKey?) including the full L18-28 silenceKey JSDoc about the non-destructive 'Don't ask again' opt-in and the danger/typed pass-through-but-ignored contract; `export` preserved.
L32-34 `InternalState extends ConfirmOptions { resolve: (ok: boolean) => void }` ported verbatim (typed param keeps required parens under arrowParens:'avoid').

L36-61 useConfirm JSDoc (promise-based dialog, `await confirm({...})` then act on boolean, spread dialogProps onto a single ConfirmDialog) including the full @example carried over verbatim; the await confirm() promise flow is platform-identical and the example is illustrative pseudo-code (the JSX/onClick live only inside the comment, never compiled, and no DOM element is imported).
L62-63 `export function useConfirm()` + `const [state, setState] = useState<InternalState | null>(null)` ported 1:1 (state name preserved).

L65-85 `confirm` useCallback ported 1:1: typed `(opts: ConfirmOptions): Promise<boolean>` (return annotation contextually types `new Promise(resolve => ...)` as Promise<boolean>, so resolve is stored into InternalState.resolve exactly as on web), the L69-76 silence short-circuit safety gate (silenceKey && variant!=='danger' && !requireTypedConfirmation && isSilenced(...)) -> `Promise.resolve(true)`, and the L77-84 `new Promise` body with the rapid double-trigger guard `if (prev) prev.resolve(false)` then `return {...opts, resolve}`. Web `(resolve) =>`/`(prev) =>` de-parenthesised to `resolve =>`/`prev =>` per native arrowParens:'avoid'; the L69-74 `&&` chain reflowed with trailing operators per native prettier. Comments preserved.

L87-92 `handleConfirm` and L94-99 `handleCancel` useCallbacks ported 1:1: setState(current => { if (current) current.resolve(true|false); return null; }); web `(current) =>` -> `current =>`. Behaviour (resolve pending promise then clear state) identical.

L101-115 `dialogProps: ConfirmDialogProps | null` ported 1:1: when state is set, builds {open:true, title, message, confirmLabel, cancelLabel, variant, requireTypedConfirmation, typedConfirmationLabel, silenceKey, onConfirm: handleConfirm, onCancel: handleCancel}; else null. Object brace spacing dropped per native prettier (bracketSpacing:false). L117 `return {confirm, dialogProps}` and L118 closing brace preserved.

No DOM/Recharts/Leaflet/web-UI imports introduced; the only import is native-safe `react`. Browser-only localStorage is substituted by the documented WebStorageLike shim with an explicit unavailable-state capability matrix.
